title.zh: 将布拉干省潘迪市镇潘迪中央学校的名称变更为Mamerto C. Bernardo纪念中央学校的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Pandi Central School Situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Mamerto C. Bernardo Memorial Central School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Pandi Central School Situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, to Mamerto C. Bernardo Memorial Central School

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1988/ra_6663_1988.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Pandi Central School situated in the Municipality of Pandi, Province of Bulacan, hereby changed to Mamerto C. Bernardo Memorial Central School.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
